headword: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません
reading: もうしわけございません
gloss: I am deeply sorry (very formal apology)

definitions.gloss: I am deeply sorry; I sincerely apologize
definitions.explanation: A very formal and polite way to apologize. More formal than 申し訳ありません, which is itself more formal than すみません. Used in business settings, customer service, and when speaking to superiors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
⟦お{待|ま}たせ→お待たせ：27262_omatase⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまい、{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
examples.english: I am sorry to have kept you waiting.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おかけ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ようなこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. I will take every care to ensure this does not happen again.

notes:
USAGE:
The most formal standard apology in modern Japanese. Used extensively in business, customer service, and formal correspondence. Often accompanied by a deep bow.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- すみません (casual-polite)
- ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧ (formal)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (very formal)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (I am terribly sorry)
- ⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません (I sincerely apologize)
- {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧… (I'm sorry, but…) — used to make polite requests
